description: This file defines a centralized API client for a web application, providing helper functions to interact with RESTful endpoints related to authentication and recipes. It manages environment-based configuration and exposes methods like apiSignIn, apiSignUp, apiGetRecipes, apiGetRecipeById, and apiAddRecipe.

methods.name: request(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs HTTP fetch requests with JSON handling, manages headers, request body serialization, and error processing.

methods.name: apiSignIn({ email, password })
methods.description: Signs in a user by posting credentials to the '/auth/signin' endpoint.

methods.name: apiSignUp({ name, email, password })
methods.description: Registers a new user by posting user details to the '/auth/signup' endpoint.

methods.name: apiGetRecipes(query)
methods.description: Fetches a list of recipes, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: apiGetRecipeById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific recipe by its ID.

methods.name: apiAddRecipe(recipe)
methods.description: Adds a new recipe by posting the recipe data to the server.

ctags.name: apiSignUp
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiSignUp({ name, email, password }) {$/
